subject: HC Exception Request — Runtime GPU pool: senior redistribution (Q2 tranche)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0000
Subject: HC Exception Request — Runtime GPU pool: senior redistribution (Q2 tranche)

Hi all,

Requesting an exception to the normal HC cadence for a short, targeted redistribution: we need to move 2 senior runtime engineers (SWE III / Sr. SWE) from the kernel squad to the runtime serving pool effective start of Q2 (target onboard window Apr 15–May 1). This is a reallocation from an underloaded kernel project that can defer two feature tracks for 6–8 weeks.

Why this matters now:
- Critical low-latency work (KV cache hotfix + batching kernel) is delaying our 99th percentile SLOs for hosted customers.
- Short-term lift will unlock a 20–25% reduction in token-cost for the busiest routes per our bench (see compbench_report_2028Q1.pdf).
- We can achieve this without net new headcount in Q2 by converting one contractor and deferring a planned hire in another squad (details in attached HC slate).

Ask: Exec-level signoff on a policy exception to reassign 2 senior slots into the runtime pool for Q2, with the understanding that net FTEs for the org remain budget-neutral for the quarter. Please review the attached HC_Slate (includes proforma costs and impact on delivery) and the short ROI summary in the Drive link.

Required approvals: Marcus (Finance lead), Jonas (VP approvals), Marissa (Eng director).

If we can get a decision by EOD Thu 3/8 we can hit the Apr ramp plan.

Attachments: hc_slate_q2.xlsx, proforma_costs_q2.pdf, compbench_report_2028Q1.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Platform Staffing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 12:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HC Exception Request — Runtime GPU pool: senior redistribution (Q2 tranche)

Kimberly — thanks for the write-up. A couple quick asks before I can sign off:

1) Can you call out the delta to FY28 run-rate (headcount and comp) vs the current baseline? The slate says "budget-neutral" but I need the per-month cash delta and the quarterly Opex change for Finance.
2) What is the delivery impact to the kernel backlog? Which two epics are being deferred and who owns the customer-facing risk mitigation plan?
3) The compbench report is helpful — can we get a side-by-side of current comp bands and proposed conversion band for the contractor candidate?

If you can drop these details (short table) I'll route to Finance and mark conditional approve.

-Marcus
VP, Finance Planning

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 16:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HC Exception Request — Runtime GPU pool: senior redistribution (Q2 tranche)

Marcus — thanks, appended the short tables below and updated the Drive slate (link in metadata). Summary:

- Run-rate delta: +$18,000/month in cash in Q2 (one-time conversion uplift), ~$0 incremental FTE count for FY28 (we defer a planned new hire in kernel squad in Q3 to offset). See proforma_costs_q2.pdf.
- Quarterly Opex change: +$54k in Q2 (one-time comp/benefits timing), annualized net neutral after hire deferral.
- Kernel backlog impact: two feature epics (K-113: dynamic-optimizer telemetry, K-114: compiler-safe refactor) will be deferred; engineering delivery owners: Priya Natarajan (tracking) and Mateo Alvarez (risk plan). Customer-facing mitigation: we will push a release note and preemptively prioritize high-impact customers (list in JIRA RINF-9123).
- Contractor conversion: candidate is currently banded at SWE II (contractor comp); proposed conversion to SWE III at market midpoint per CompBench recs. Attachment "compbench_report_2028Q1.pdf" has band mapping.

I pasted the small table here for quick review:

| Line item | Monthly cash delta | Q2 delta | Notes |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Conversion uplift (one-time) | $18,000 | $54,000 | pro-rated sign-on & benefits
| Deferred hire savings | -$18,000 | -$54,000 | deferral of kernel new hire (Q3)
| Net Q2 cash | $0 | $0 | budget-neutral after internal offset

Given the net-zero headcount, this is a policy exception (timing) rather than a new budget ask. Happy to push final numbers into the Finance template if that helps.

Kimberly
Head of Platform Staffing Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: hc_slate_q2.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 09:41:00 -0000
Subject: Re: HC Exception Request — Runtime GPU pool: senior redistribution (Q2 tranche)

Kimberly / team — I appreciate the concise ROI. Conditional approval from me: move the two senior slots into runtime for the Q2 window on the terms you described, provided:

- We convert the contractor as proposed (banding validated by CompBench).
- Marissa signs off on execution plan for the deferred kernel epics (customer mitigations), and
- Finance records the proforma in the FY28 runbook (Marcus to verify).

Marcus — please flag if anything in the proforma requires exec finance review that might delay the timeline.

Jonas
VP, Platform Engineering

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: DocuSign <no-reply@docusign.net>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 15:18:00 -0000
Subject: Approval + next steps: Runtime redistribution (Q2)

Thanks — I reviewed the plan and the kernel mitigation notes. Marissa here: approve to proceed with the two-slot redistribution on the conditions Jonas listed. Action items: 

1) Kimberly — please issue the formal HC change memo and update headcount tracker. Attach the signed slate to the tracker.
2) Marcus — please load the proforma (proforma_costs_q2.pdf) into the FY28 runbook and confirm cost-code (CC: PLAT-RUN-2028-Q2).
3) Soojin — loop in People Ops for contractor conversion paperwork and confirm final comp band per CompBench.
4) Kimberly — once People Ops confirms banding, please route the DocuSign envelope (I started the envelope; link in metadata) and we will finalize offer terms for the conversion candidate.

I am marking this approved; please follow the tracker steps and confirm when the DocuSign is completed.

- Marissa Cole
Director, Runtime & Serving
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proforma_costs_q2.pdf
